    HullNode from the chain-bounded case #

    Bongartz (Indecomposables live in all smaller lengths, proof of Theorem 2) splits into three cases: no long morphism (hullFinite_of_not_hasLong), a crown and a long morphism (reduce to P/μ by Proposition 2, prop2Node_of, and hullFinite_of_residue), and the chain-bounded case (Fischbacher, Satz 5.1). The last case is the node ChainHullNode.
